title: Hunts FH-038S: Offer admin screen and order settlement call for store items

source.ref: Split from FH-036..040 (2026-11-10): the pure core, storage and tests shipped dark behind HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED; the live call sites move here.

detail: Add the screen where a Space owner approves a store item for a Hunt (writes hunt_store_offers), render the deep link through resolveStoreLink, and call planOrderProjection and projectUnit from the commerce order settlement and refund paths. Done when: a quantity-two bound line replayed gives two benefits and a refunded unit revokes only its own. Requires: FH-038, FH-037S. Owner role: Commerce.
